name: Acer Gadget Inc.
summary: Operating both within Taiwan and globally, Acer Gadget Inc. specializes in the design, leasing, and sale of a wide array of products. These offerings span computer software, hardware application systems, peripheral devices, and smart lifestyle solutions. Among its specific product categories are wearable items like the ePay series, lovecode, and faith bracelets. The company also furnishes essential computer accessories, including mice, keyboards, webcams, and protective sleeves. Furthermore, Acer Gadget Inc. extends its portfolio to include scooters and various bag products. Established in 1975, the company's main operations are based in Taipei City, Taiwan, and it functions as a subsidiary of Acer Inc.
